data.sections.leg_arm.x.description: Sets position of the foot on the X axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.y.description: Sets position of the foot on the Y axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.copyFrom.descripti: Copy from another leg. Useful to only need to set leg values once
data.sections.leg_arm.attach_x.descripti: Sets the leg's attach point on the X axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.attach_y.descripti: Sets the leg's attach point on the Y axis.
data.sections.leg_arm.rotateSpeed.descri: Sets the leg's rotation speed on movement
data.sections.leg_arm.endDirOffset.descr: Target foot/end rotation relative to body
data.sections.leg_arm.lockMovement.descr: Lock to unit body. Useful if walking unit converted to a flying unit.
data.sections.leg_arm.heightSpeed.descri: Sets how fast the leg rises while walking
data.sections.leg_arm.moveSpeed.descript: Sets how fast the leg moves while walking
data.sections.leg_arm.holdDisMin.descrip: Defaults to 7. Reposition leg at this distance if neighbor legs are not already repositioning.
data.sections.leg_arm.holdDisMax.descrip: Defaults to 16. Force reposition of leg at this distance. Repositions leg at this distance even if a neighboring leg is moving
data.sections.leg_arm.holdDisMin_maxMovi: Hold Distance Minimum Max Moving Legs
Sets maximum amount of legs to check before applying distance holding
data.sections.leg_arm.hold_moveOnlyIfFur: Defaults to true. When true, starting moving leg only if it is currently the furthest leg from where it should be.
data.sections.leg_arm.holdDisMin_checkNe: Checks neighbors before applying distance holding
data.sections.leg_arm.hardLimit.descript: Defaults to 50. Force leg to never go this far. Better to not be reached.
data.sections.leg_arm.estimatingPosition: defaults to 1. Predicts were unit will be for leg placement based on unit speed.
data.sections.leg_arm.image_end.descript: Sets the main arm end sprite
data.sections.leg_arm.image_end_shadow.d: Sets the shadow for the arm
data.sections.leg_arm.image_end_teamColo: When true, the arm end will apply team colors
data.sections.leg_arm.image_foot.descrip: same as image_end, but acts as the foot for the leg
Sets the shadow for the foot
data.sections.leg_arm.drawDirOffset.desc: Rotates the foot/arm sprite to a specified direction
data.sections.leg_arm.dust_effect.descri: Spawns dust particles on each step.
data.sections.leg_arm.spinRate.descripti: Makes arm/leg spin, like idleSpin for turrets. Great for helicopters
data.sections.leg_arm.favourOppositeSide: calculate neighbours with X 10 times closer than Y
data.sections.leg_arm.drawLegWhenZoomedO: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size
data.sections.leg_arm.drawFootWhenZoomed: For performance, defaults changes based on unit size
data.sections.leg_arm.targetHeightRelati: Apply height relative to unit's height
